rationale: Price is in a clear downtrend on the 1-minute bars, falling from $57.83 to $57.51 over the last five candles with accelerating volume on the down moves, and is trading well below both the session VWAP ($58.10) and the 9-EMA ($57.94), indicating bearish short-term momentum. The risk/reward in either direction lacks a clean structural level to anchor a stop with sufficient reward potential given the ATR and remaining session time.
